test_title: PYST 8: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"recurred."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Recurred"** means to happen or appear again after a period of time. (दोबारा या अनेक बार घटित होना; पुनरावृत्त होना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The theme of freedom **recurred**__ throughout her writing.*
 
 
 
• This is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank, as the other options do not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• The word is in the past tense, indicating that something happened in the past and is now happening again.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
 
• Correct passage:

The Grim Reaper seems to have __appeared__ in Europe during the 14th century. It was during this time that Europe was dealing with what was then the world’s __worst__ pandemic, the Black Death, believed to be the result of the plague. It is estimated that about one-third of Europe’s entire population __perished__ as a result of the pandemic, with some areas of the continent suffering far greater losses than others. The original outbreak of the plague occurred during 1347–51, and outbreaks then __**recurred**__ several other times after that. So, clearly, death was something that the surviving Europeans had on their mind, and it is not surprising that they ______ (5) ______ an image to represent it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Remaked"** is not a word in standard English. The correct form would be** "remade."**
 
• **"Renewed"** means to make something new again, but does not fit the context of the sentence. ((किसी काम को) फिर से शुरू करना)
 
• **"Duplicated"** means to make an exact copy of something, but does not fit the context of the sentence. (किसी वस्‍तु की सही नक़ल बना लेना; अनुलिपि बनाना)

47:T100b,

The correct answer is **"conjured."**
